name: Longkamp (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Longkamp (a red saltire on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Longkamp; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Longkamp arms — saltire on white and green
